notes: The fed's own monthly PPV. Bruiser Brody wins the EXTREME Title from Faarooq in a broken-glass match; Chyna becomes the first female AOLWF champion, defeating Jushin Liger for the Lightweight Title after Shane Douglas's Triple Threat stable takes out the originally-scheduled challenger Psicosis; Honky Tonk Man wins the Television Title from Rick Rude; "Destruction" (Ahmed Johnson & Lex Luger) are billed for the World Tag Team Titles against the Pitbulls. Shawn Michaels is billed mid-card as the fed's new United States Champion; the actual title-change match is not among the surviving parts (gap-registered).
